questions.prompt: What is true about Spain's Paralympic basketball team?

choices.html: A person lied to them to expose the truth.
One of its players told the truth.
None of the players had disabilities.
used drugs to compete in 1999, 2005, and 2012.
lost most of his Tour de France titles.
told the truth in front of the cameras.
